description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment, representing a comment token in the HTMLPurifier library, including its properties and methods for constructing and converting to a node.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment
classes.description: A class representing a comment token within the HTMLPurifier library, used to encapsulate comment data during HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment with comment data, line, and column information.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Converts this token into an HTMLPurifier_Node_Comment object, representing the comment node in the DOM.
